parts.text: 模板字符串里的反引号转义出了问题，改用占位符重写：

tool_input.code:
const BT = "~BT~";
const content = [
"---",
"date: 2026-10-21",
"place: 办公室",
"tags: [学习, 可复用模板]",
"---",
"",
"> **换机复刻 DSH 环境的完整档案**：这台电脑（办公室机）上 DeepSeek Harness 的插件、市场索引、模型/权限配置、记忆与性格数据的位置。家里的新电脑照着这份文件走一遍，就能得到近乎同一个“第二大脑 AI”。截至 2026-10，插件版本以当日实装为准。",
"",
"## 1 · 是什么",
"",
"DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的“性格 + 记忆”由两个插件分担，**数据都是纯本地文件夹，拷走即迁移**：",
"",
"| 插件 | 管什么 | 数据在哪 |",
"|---|---|---|",
"| **灵枢** " + BT + "@furongjun1999/dsh-memory" + BT + " | 长期记忆 + 性格形成。五层认知图（anchor/structural/knowledge/contextual/**self**），self 层存身份与性格 traits；带遗忘、巩固、演化、睡眠整理机制 | " + BT + "~/.dsh/.dsh-memory/" + BT + " |",
"| **OpenViking** " + BT + "@openviking/dsh-memory-plugin" + BT + " | 跨项目持久上下文：历史会话检索、经验记忆、技能库（viking:// skills） | " + BT + "~/.openviking/" + BT + " |",
"",
"> AI 推测：截至 2026-10-21，灵枢只积累了 contextual 层 15 条记忆，self/性格层尚为空——性格迁移目前主要是“机制就位”，实质内容还在早期。",
"",
"## 2 · 已装插件（8 个，2026-10-21 实装）",
"",
"| 包名 | 版本 | 来源 | 作用 |",
"|---|---|---|---|",
"| " + BT + "@furongjun1999/dsh-memory" + BT + " | 0.9.8 | npm | 灵枢：记忆+性格 |",
"| " + BT + "@openviking/dsh-memory-plugin" + BT + " | 0.5.27 | npm | OpenViking 持久上下文 |",
"| " + BT + "dsh-grill-first" + BT + " | 0.1.1 | **GitHub** " + BT + "github:InoriMutsumi/dsh-grill-first" + BT + " | 开工前需求确认门禁 |",
"| " + BT + "dsh-our-free-model" + BT + " | 2.5.4 | **GitHub** " + BT + "github:Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model" + BT + " | 免费模型接入 |",
"| " + BT + "dsh-providers-hub" + BT + " | 1.10.261021 | npm | 模型提供商聚合 |",
"| " + BT + "@1e0zj/dsh-plugin-mall" + BT + " | 0.4.17 | npm | 插件市场 UI |",
"| " + BT + "@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer" + BT + " | 0.4.8 | npm | 技能浏览器 |",
"| " + BT + "@tt-a1i/archify-dsh" + BT + " | 0.1.0 | npm | 架构图生成 |",
"",
"> 后两个 GitHub 源插件在市场里可能搜不到，装的时候必须用 " + BT + "github:" + BT + " 前缀指定。",
"",
"## 3 · 插件市场索引（5 个，写进 cordis.patch.yml 的 plugin-market.config）",
"",
BT + BT + BT + "yaml",
"- id: plugin-market",
'  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market"',
"  config:",
"    indexes:",
'      - "https://dshmarketplace.dev/market/index.json"',
'      - "https://dshmarket.com/index.json"',
'      - "https://realoiyo.github.io/dsh-plugin-market/index.json"',
'      - "https://dshopen.org/index.json"',
'      - "https://dsh.store/plugin-market.json"',
BT + BT + BT,
"",
"## 4 · 关键配置（cordis.patch.yml 摘要）",
"",
"| 配置项 | 值 |",
"|---|---|",
"| 默认模型 | provider=" + BT + "aggregate" + BT + "，model=" + BT + "glm-5-3" + BT + "，reasoningEffort=" + BT + "high" + BT + " |",
"| 权限预设 | " + BT + "danger-full-access" + BT + "（默认），approval=never |",
"| agent preset | default=" + BT + "standard" + BT + "，selectedDefault=" + BT + "ptc" + BT + " |",
"| ui-chat | transcriptView=" + BT + "standard" + BT + "，performanceUsage=" + BT + "detailed" + BT + "，linkOpening=" + BT + "new-tab" + BT + " |",
"| grill-first | strict 模式，3 问 × 3 轮，standard 强度，memoryEnabled |",
"",
"## 5 · 记忆与性格数据位置（迁移就是拷这些目录）",
"",
"| 数据 | 位置 | 当前规模（2026-10-21） |",
"|---|---|---|",
"| 灵枢认知图（含性格 self 层） | " + BT + "C:\\Users\\jjq21\\.dsh\\.dsh-memory\\data\\mdcg\\" + BT + " | contextual 15 条，self 层空 |",
"| 灵枢睡眠/整理 | " + BT + "C:\\Users\\jjq21\\.dsh\\.dsh-memory\\sleep\\" + BT + " | _sleep.jsonl |",
"| OpenViking 持久上下文 | " + BT + "C:\\Users\\jjq21\\.openviking\\" + BT + " | pending 1406 个事件文件 |",
"| grill-first 全局记忆 | " + BT + "C:\\Users\\jjq21\\.dsh\\grill-first\\global.json" + BT + " | 用户偏好 |",
"| DSH 会话历史 | " + BT + "C:\\Users\\jjq21\\.dsh\\sessions\\" + BT + "、" + BT + "storages\\" + BT + " | 30+ 会话 |",
"| 凭证（**只抄位置不抄内容进 git**） | " + BT + "C:\\Users\\jjq21\\.dsh\\.credentials.yaml" + BT + " | 需在新机重新登录 |",
"",
"> 换机时用户名不同的机器，路径里的 " + BT + "jjq21" + BT + " 换成新机的用户目录。",
"",
"## 6 · 家里新电脑复刻步骤（6 步）",
"",
"1. **装 DSH**：安装 DeepSeek Harness，首次启动生成 " + BT + "~/.dsh" + BT + "。",
"2. **修 git 凭证**：按 [[Git 凭证弹窗反复出现（helper-selector）]] 在 " + BT + "~/.gitconfig" + BT + " 写入 credential 三行（helper 空值 + manager），否则 push 卡弹窗。",
"3. **拉第二大脑**：" + BT + "git clone https://github.com/jjq1993148743/My-second-brain.git" + BT + "，读 AGENTS.md。",
"4. **装 8 个插件**（" + BT + "dsh plugin --profile desktop add <spec>" + BT + "）：npm 源的 6 个按上表包名+版本装；grill-first 和 our-free-model 用 " + BT + "github:InoriMutsumi/dsh-grill-first" + BT + "、" + BT + "github:Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model" + BT + "。装完把第 3、4 节的配置贴进 " + BT + "cordis.patch.yml" + BT + "。",
"5. **拷记忆数据**：从旧机整目录拷贝 " + BT + ".dsh-memory" + BT + "（灵枢）、" + BT + "~/.openviking" + BT + "（OpenViking）、" + BT + ".dsh\\grill-first" + BT + "（偏好）到新机对应位置；DSH 处于关闭状态时拷。",
"6. **重启 DSH 验证**：开新会话问“你还记得我吗”，灵枢记忆能召回即成功。",
"",
"> AI 推测：插件大版本更新后 mdcg 数据格式可能有迁移逻辑，拷贝前先把旧机 " + BT + ".dsh-memory" + BT + " 打包备份一份，新机插件版本尽量与上表一致。",
"",
"## 7 · 维护",
"",
"- 每次装/卸插件或改默认模型后，更新第 2、4 节并随库推送。",
"- 版本号写在表里就是为了换机时“锁版本对照”，不要删。",
""
].join("\n").split(BT).join("`");

const w = await tools.write({ file_path: "D:\\GitHub\\My-second-brain\\50-知识\\DSH 环境档案（换机复刻指南）.md", content });
return w.operation;
tool_input.description: 写入 DSH 环境档案文件
